k.q: Predict the exact output of this OCR ERL program, change one value, then extend the program.
k.code:
age = 17
member = true
if age >= 16 AND member == true then
    print("Allowed")
else
    print("Not allowed")
endif
p: Predict the output of the supplied code.
Change member to false and predict output.
Replace AND with OR; predict the result using age 17 and member false.
k.a:
Original output: Allowed.

After the changes: With AND and false member: Not allowed. With OR: Allowed.

Recheck the calculation and indentation using OCR ERL.
